verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an export capability: there is no workflow or credential export, no bulk data download, and no description of export formats. Self-hosting, Git version control, the CLI and the API appear only as headings or deployment claims, which are adjacent features belonging to other stories rather than a documented way to export all data in open formats. Data-portability is a fair axis for a workflow automation platform, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
